evidence.r1: The selected-vehicle platter (camera photo plus headway, operator and load grid) and the alerts sidebar are content surfaces drawn as floating glass-rimmed panels.
evidence.r2: The action bar sits below the platter, not on it; the selected route, status and alert rows are fills.
evidence.r3: Five glass elements at rest (sidebar, route filter, status filter, search, zoom), plus the platter and action bar on selection; each is functional.
evidence.r4: The filters, search, zoom and action bar share one regular material in both schemes.
evidence.r6: Only 'Call operator', the primary action, carries a strong fill (black in light, white in dark), on its background.
evidence.r7: The sidebar and vehicle-platter bodies are flat opaque fills (pixel-uniform over the map, unchanged by reduce transparency) in both schemes.
evidence.r8: Capsule filters, search, zoom and action bar; a fixed-radius sidebar and platter.
evidence.r9: The selected alert row and the platter photo follow their panels' radii; 'Call operator' is concentric in the action bar.
evidence.r10: The floating buttons and filters are capsules.
evidence.r11: The top holds three groups: route filter, status filter, search.
evidence.r12: The action bar puts the Call operator, Hold and Follow text buttons on the same glass as the '×' icon button (menu, both schemes).
evidence.r13: Material sits on each bar; the chips and buttons inside are fills.
evidence.r14: The route and status filters are deliberately separate adjacent pills; the platter and action bar keep a clear gap.
evidence.r15: The map pans rather than scrolls, and the six alerts fit without scrolling, so nothing scrolls under a bar and no edge effect is needed.
evidence.r16: All glass sits over the street-grid map in both schemes.
evidence.r17: At rest the routes and markers are framed right of the sidebar, clear of the top bars and the zoom.
evidence.r18: The search placeholder is ~5.3:1 (light), filter labels over 11:1, platter labels ~5.9:1.
evidence.r19: Reduced capture: the glass goes opaque and everything stays readable; the filter bar and zoom only shift slightly right.
evidence.r20: The map runs to every window edge, including under the sidebar at the left.
evidence.r21: The map continues beneath the sidebar (visible in the left margin), with routes framed clear of it.
evidence.r22: The sidebar and platter carry a custom opaque background with a drawn border rather than the bare material.
evidence.r23: The vehicle platter appears at the right edge, detached from the alert row and the marker that opened it.
evidence.r24: The route filter toolbar carries saturated route-colour dots, and the sidebar's alert icons are red and amber.
evidence.r25: Labels are dark on light glass (light) and white on dark glass (dark), apart from the map colours.
